analysis_subject: Tolerate vendor/underscore suffixes in Linux kernel release strings; add graceful fallback probing when uname parsing fails on 32-bit Linux

analysis_summary.adjudication_reason: All 4 candidate hunks involve changes internal to the 'runtime' package. The changed functions (getKernelVersion, parseRelease, configure64bitsTimeOn32BitsArchitectures, probeFutexTime64) are lowercase (unexported) Go identifiers with no callers outside src/runtime/. The only exported symbol (ParseRelease) is in a _test.go file, compiled only during testing. The patch is a bug fix: it makes kernel version parsing tolerant of '_' suffixes (Synology kernels) and replaces unrecoverable throw() calls with graceful false returns plus optional probing fallback. No public API, CLI, config, protocol, or ABI surfaces are affected.
analysis_summary.adjudication_notes: HUNK-0001 (export_linux_test.go): Test-only export, not public API. HUNK-0002 (os_linux.go): getKernelVersion() signature change internal to runtime; parseRelease() made more tolerant (additive change, accepts all previous inputs plus underscore-suffixed ones). HUNK-0003 (os_linux32.go): Fallback probeFutexTime64() added for unparseable kernel versions; only reached when getKernelVersion() fails (which previously crashed). HUNK-0004 (runtime_linux_test.go): New test-only function.
